create_constant_variation: create a Constant variation that always returns a fixed value when called
create_sequence_variation: create a Sequence variation that returns values from a fixed list in order and loops
create_identity_variation: create an Identity variation that returns the current_value passed to it
test_constant_equality: test that two Constant variations with the same value compare equal
test_sequence_looping: test that a Sequence variation restarts from the beginning after exhausting all values
